g.text: U2701 generates CMD_USB_RAW, CMD_SYS_RAW, CMD_FPGA_RAW and CMD_ANA_RAW.

g.desc: U2701 generates CMD_USB_RAW, CMD_SYS_RAW, CMD_FPGA_RAW and CMD_ANA_RAW.

g.text: U2702 generates CMD_P15_RAW, CMD_N15_RAW, CMD_CORE_RAW and CMD_AUX18_RAW.

g.desc: U2702 generates CMD_P15_RAW, CMD_N15_RAW, CMD_CORE_RAW and CMD_AUX18_RAW.

g.text: Each channel receives GLOBAL_PWR_PERMIT and its corresponding

g.desc: Each channel receives GLOBAL_PWR_PERMIT and its corresponding

g.text: EN_REQ signal from the power manager.

g.desc: EN_REQ signal from the power manager.

g.text: This AON-powered gate bank turns the power manager requests into

g.desc: This AON-powered gate bank turns the power manager requests into

g.text: hardware-qualified commands for the primary MIRA supply domains.

g.desc: hardware-qualified commands for the primary MIRA supply domains.

g.text: It enables staged startup while the global permit remains valid,

g.desc: It enables staged startup while the global permit remains valid,

g.text: and removes all eight commands when that permit is cleared.

g.desc: and removes all eight commands when that permit is cleared.

g.text: Clearing GLOBAL_PWR_PERMIT drives every command LOW, even if

g.desc: Clearing GLOBAL_PWR_PERMIT drives every command LOW, even if

g.text: a firmware request remains HIGH. A request released by the MCU

g.desc: a firmware request remains HIGH. A request released by the MCU

g.text: also goes LOW through its pull-down. Rail shutdown time depends

g.desc: also goes LOW through its pull-down. Rail shutdown time depends

g.text: on the connected converter or switch and its output capacitance.

g.desc: on the connected converter or switch and its output capacitance.

g.text: Every channel uses the same rule:

g.desc: Every channel uses the same rule:

g.text: Sheet 5300 passes these commands only after STARTUP_READY_H.

g.desc: Sheet 5300 passes these commands only after STARTUP_READY_H.

g.text: The power manager chooses the sequence and explicitly arms permits.

g.desc: The power manager chooses the sequence and explicitly arms permits.

g.text: All request and command lines have 100 kOhm pull-downs.

g.desc: All request and command lines have 100 kOhm pull-downs.

g.text: C2701/C2702 (100 nF) bypass the two SN74HC08 supplies to GND.

g.desc: C2701/C2702 (100 nF) bypass the two SN74HC08 supplies to GND.

g.text: This sheet contains no startup delay or voltage/current setting;

g.desc: This sheet contains no startup delay or voltage/current setting;

g.text: those settings belong to the sequencer and the rail circuits.

g.desc: those settings belong to the sequencer and the rail circuits.

g.text: Raw CMD = request AND global permit; qualified on sheet 5300

g.desc: Raw CMD = request AND global permit; qualified on sheet 5300
